description: Credential patterns for the secret_pattern detector (SPEC §2.10). Patterns are RE2- and ECMAScript-compatible with flags passed separately: Go compiles "(?flags)" + pattern when flags is non-empty, JS compiles new RegExp(pattern, flags + "g"). The detector always runs; every pattern is matched against the gated response text, and a match fires only when its exact text does not occur in user_request (a user pasting their own key is not a leak). Patterns are applied in order; a match that overlaps an earlier finding is not reported again, so the specific key formats listed first win over the generic sk- pattern. Findings carry UTF-16 offsets; runners must not persist the matched text unmasked.
